description: Literacy: From letter recognition to reading comprehension

tasks.instruction: Listen: 'The dog ran fast.' Who ran?
tasks.passage: Listen: 'The dog ran fast.' Who ran?

tasks.scaffolding_hint: Say: "Rhyming words end with the same sound — cat, hat, mat"

tasks.instruction: Listen: 'Maria ate an apple because she was hungry.' Why did Maria eat?
tasks.scaffolding_hint: Say: "The sentence tells you why — listen for the word 'because'"
tasks.passage: Listen: 'Maria ate an apple because she was hungry.' Why did Maria eat?

tasks.instruction: Listen to the story: 'Ben had 5 toys. He gave 2 to his sister.' How many does Ben have now?
tasks.scaffolding_hint: Say: "He started with 5 and gave away 2"
tasks.passage: Listen to the story: 'Ben had 5 toys. He gave 2 to his sister.' How many does Ben have now?

tasks.instruction: Read: 'The old house creaked in the wind. No one had lived there for years.' What is the mood?
tasks.scaffolding_hint: Say: "What feeling do the words 'creaked' and 'no one' give you?"
tasks.passage: Read: 'The old house creaked in the wind. No one had lived there for years.' What is the mood?

tasks.instruction: Read the paragraph. What is the main idea?
tasks.scaffolding_hint: Say: "The main idea is what the whole paragraph is mostly about"
tasks.passage: Read the paragraph. What is the main idea?

tasks.instruction: Read the passage. What can you infer about the character's feelings?
tasks.scaffolding_hint: Say: "The author doesn't say directly — use clues from the words"
tasks.passage: Read the passage. What can you infer about the character's feelings?

tasks.instruction: Read the argument. What is the author's main claim?
tasks.scaffolding_hint: Say: "The claim is the main point the author is trying to prove"
tasks.passage: Read the argument. What is the author's main claim?

tasks.instruction: Read the passage. Identify the figurative language and explain its meaning.
tasks.scaffolding_hint: Say: "Figurative language uses comparison or exaggeration to make a point"
tasks.passage: Read the passage. Identify the figurative language and explain its meaning.

tasks.instruction: In a negotiation, one party suddenly becomes very agreeable after being resistant. What might this signal?
tasks.scaffolding_hint: Say: "Sudden changes in behavior during negotiations can have multiple meanings"
options: They are being honest, They gave up, They are confused
tasks.correct_answer: They are being honest, They gave up, They are confused
tasks.passage: In a negotiation, one party suddenly becomes very agreeable after being resistant. What might this signal?

tasks.instruction: Read the two passages with opposing views. What is the key point of disagreement?
tasks.scaffolding_hint: Say: "Look past the examples — what fundamental idea do they disagree on?"
tasks.passage: Read the two passages with opposing views. What is the key point of disagreement?
